description: This Java class implements a singleton converter that translates exceptions into acknowledgement messages with an internal server error status. It extends a base converter class and provides a specific implementation for handling generic exceptions by returning the HTTP 500 status code.

classes.name: DefaultExceptionToAcknowledgementConverter
classes.description: A singleton class that converts exceptions into acknowledgement messages with a 500 Internal Server Error status.

methods.name: getInstance
methods.description: Returns the singleton instance of this converter, creating it if necessary.

methods.name: getStatusCodeForGenericException
methods.description: Overrides the base method to return HttpStatusCode.INTERNAL_SERVER_ERROR for generic exceptions.
